fyo:provider_resolution.resolution_rule: a measurement-ordered Dataset kind (its providers carry measurement_chain) is resolved within the measurement's chain: the provider whose shot range covers the shot, else that chain's rangeless provider — a gap in the chain, two covering providers or an undeclared chain is refused; with no chain, the same rule within the chain of the kind's manifest default provider (user ruling 2026-09-14: the default geometry follows the default fetch's chain); for every other kind: the shot-anchored provider covering the shot — several covering: the narrowest range, then the manifest default, then the one marked preferred, then the first in manifest order — and with no shot the one covering the open upper end (no shot = the latest shot); otherwise the manifest default (user rulings R-S1 / R-S2 and the measurement-chain ruling, 2026-09-13)

pf_active.fylite:pairing: element rectangles from the geometry provider in deck order; turns, fast coils, supplies and the BRSP circuit from the electrical provider, each paired to its deck element by rectangle centre. `supply[i]` drives element i.
pf_active.fylite:resistance_note: PF channel `resistance` is RECOMPUTED on the cross-sections this document carries: R = η·Σ2πr·N²/(w·h) over the channel's elements, η = 0.017 μΩ·m recovered from the electrical provider's own `resistance` on its own geometry (user ruling 2026-09-13). Fast coils keep the provider's value: their geometry is that provider's, so the two already agree.
